pages.lesson:
LESSON: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.5: Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Which things make a narrative composition memorable?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing
2. create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics
3. appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions

Teach
• Focus skill: identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which things make a narrative composition memorable?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
